message: Conversation titled: Calculus A-Grade Study Plan

tasks.title: Calculus Week 1: Limits and Continuity
tasks.description: Master the foundations of limits and the concept of continuity.

subtasks.title: Limit Laws and Algebraic Evaluation
subtasks.description: Review rules for evaluating limits including the Squeeze Theorem.

payload.initial_prompt: Help me master limit laws and algebraic techniques for evaluating limits, including the Squeeze Theorem. Focus on common pitfalls and rigorous proofs.

task_plan.unit_description: Foundational rules for sum, product, and quotient limits.

tasks.task_description: Mastering factoring and rationalizing to solve indeterminate forms.
Applying the Squeeze Theorem to trigonometric and bounded functions.

subtasks.title: Continuity and Infinity
subtasks.description: Study one-sided limits and behavior at infinity.

payload.initial_prompt: Explain the formal definition of continuity and how to evaluate limits at infinity or vertical asymptotes.

task_plan.unit_description: Types of discontinuities and asymptotic behavior.

tasks.task_description: Checking the three conditions for continuity at a point.
Finding horizontal asymptotes using degree analysis.

subtasks.title: Practice: Limits & Continuity
subtasks.description: Solve set of 20 practice problems ranging from basic to advanced.

tasks.title: Calculus Week 2: Differentiation Rules
tasks.description: Focus on the mechanics of finding derivatives using various rules.

subtasks.title: Core Differentiation Rules
subtasks.description: Master Power, Product, Quotient, and Chain rules.

payload.initial_prompt: I need to practice the Chain Rule combined with Product and Quotient rules. Provide complex nested problems.

tasks.task_description: Speed drill for Power and Quotient rules.
Differentiating functions with multiple layers of composition.

subtasks.title: Transcendental & Implicit Differentiation
subtasks.description: Derivatives of logs, exponentials, and implicit functions.

payload.initial_prompt: Teach me implicit differentiation and the derivatives of e^x, ln(x), and inverse trig functions.

tasks.task_description: Differentiating equations where y is not isolated.
Using logs to simplify complex products before differentiating.

tasks.title: Calculus Week 3: Applications & Review
tasks.description: Apply derivatives to real-world problems and prepare for the exam.

subtasks.title: Optimization and Related Rates
subtasks.description: Solve word problems involving rates of change and extrema.

payload.initial_prompt: Let's work on Related Rates and Optimization word problems. Focus on setting up the equations from text.

task_plan.unit_description: Translating physical scenarios into calculus equations.

tasks.task_description: Solving problems involving time-based derivatives of multiple variables.
Finding absolute maxima and minima in practical contexts.

subtasks.title: Curve Sketching and Theorems
subtasks.description: Use MVT, L'Hopital's, and derivative tests to analyze functions.

payload.initial_prompt: Review Mean Value Theorem, L'Hopital's Rule, and the Second Derivative Test for concavity.

task_plan.unit_description: Using derivatives to describe function behavior.

tasks.task_description: Determining intervals of increase/decrease and concavity.
Using derivatives to find limits of indeterminate forms.

subtasks.title: Final Exam Prep & Mock Exam
subtasks.description: Generate a summary cheatsheet and complete a timed mock exam.

payload.initial_prompt: Generate a comprehensive one-page cheatsheet for differential calculus covering all major rules and theorems.

tasks.title: Calculus Final Exam
tasks.description: Main exam covering all differential calculus topics.
